_comment: Human-maintained status overrides for reports/verification/evidence_registry.csv. An override can only lower a status (VERIFIED -> PARTIAL/BLOCKED/FAILED) and must carry a reason. Remove the entry once the blocker is cleared.

DATA-02.limitations: Downloads run on the author's workstation (cloud container cannot reach NYC Open Data). speed-links --since 2026-01-01 timed out server-side 6x; link set is 'active since 2026-09-20' (125 links).

PACK-01.limitations: docker compose build not executed end-to-end: Docker Hub pulls are rate-limited from the development container. Compose/Dockerfiles are present and `docker compose config` validates against .env.example.

PAPER-01.limitations: Paper tables are generated from artifacts; results/discussion sections are filled only after the real-data run and bibliography entries remain NOT_YET_CHECKED (paper/REFERENCES_STATUS.md).
